title: Bridgeside Bookhouse: A Mock Weekly Report
sourceTitle: A fully simulated weekly data report; the bookhouse, the stats and the numbers are all fictional and reflect no real business.

scenes.title: Headline and Scope
scenes.narration: The mock bookhouse lent 84 books this week. It counts loans logged Monday through Sunday.
scenes.sourceQuote: The mock bookhouse lent 84 books this week. It counts loans logged Monday through Sunday.

scenes.title: Three Measures
scenes.narration: The same sheet tracks three measures. It logged 60 visitors and 42 borrowers. And 79 books were returned.
scenes.sourceQuote: The same sheet tracks three measures. It logged 60 visitors and 42 borrowers. And 79 books were returned.

scenes.title: The Spike
scenes.narration: Wednesday saw 22 loans, the week's high. This sheet can't say if an event caused it.
scenes.sourceQuote: Wednesday saw 22 loans, the week's high. This sheet can't say if an event caused it.

scenes.title: Limits and Next Steps
scenes.narration: This is only one week of mock data. Keep the same scope next week. Then see if the peak comes back.
